tasks.title: Reveal the AdminHeader bar as one unit on mount
acceptance_criteria: The header root renders through Reveal (as="header") so it fades/rises in on mount, keeping its existing inline styles, border, flex layout, and children (SaveBar, logout, mobile back).
The back-link, title, subtitle, and save/logout controls are unchanged in copy, order, and behavior.
No new CSS; index.css is untouched.
tests: AdminHeader renders its title and subtitle inside an element carrying the reveal class (entrance preserved, copy intact).
The header's children (passed via children prop) still render alongside the title.

tasks.title: Stagger the DayPicker sidebar rows with a per-index delay
acceptance_criteria: Each sidebar row — the '7 prochains jours' label, the 7 day buttons, the 'Autres' label, and the Vigilance and 'Note de Nicolas' buttons — renders through Reveal with delaySeconds = index * 0.05, producing a downward cascade.
Rows are revealed at the row-element level (day/other buttons become Reveal as="button", labels become Reveal divs); the aside container and the adm-layout-grid tracks are NOT wrapped.
onSelect fires on click for every row, hover background still toggles, and SelectedBar still renders on the selected row.
The aside's overflow:auto, gap, and column layout are unchanged; no new CSS.
tests: DayPicker renders all 7 day rows plus the Vigilance and 'Note de Nicolas' buttons.
Clicking a day row calls onSelect with that day's id (interactivity preserved through the Reveal wrapper).
Clicking the Vigilance row calls onSelect with '__vigilance' and the Note row with '__advice'.
The selected row still renders the SelectedBar accent.

tasks.title: Reveal the editor section once on mount without replay on day/tab switch
acceptance_criteria: The editor <section class="adm-editor-section"> renders through Reveal (as="section") so it fades/rises in on mount, settling after the header and sidebar.
The section keeps its overflow:auto and background, and stays mounted across selection changes so switching day/Vigilance/Note swaps contents in place without replaying the entrance.
The adm-layout-grid grid, its two tracks (DayPicker aside + editor section), and mobile view classes are unchanged; no new CSS.
tests: AdminLayout renders the editor section with the reveal class and the active editor inside it.
Changing the selected id swaps the editor content while the same section element stays mounted (no re-mount, no re-reveal).

out_of_scope: Any change to src/index.css or the shared .reveal primitives.
New keyframes/CSS unless a motion beyond .reveal proves necessary.
Editor logic, forecast data, save/publish, auth, routing, layout, or color changes.
Re-revealing the editor panel on day/tab switch (reveals once on mount only).
